mapper.select: SELECT n.incident_id,n.fingerprint,n.generation_no,n.status,n.event_count, n.opened_at,n.last_event_at,n.recovered_at,n.summary,n.lock_version, n.created_at,n.updated_at, (SELECT e.alert_cycle_ref FROM alert_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND e.alert_event_id=n.first_event_id) AS cycle_ref FROM incident n WHERE n.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND n.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND n.status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM incident i JOIN alert_event e ON e.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND e.alert_event_id=i.first_event_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.incident_id=#{incidentId} AND i.status='RECOVERED' AND e.event_type='RESOLVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT n.incident_id,n.fingerprint,n.generation_no,n.status,n.event_count, n.opened_at,n.last_event_at,n.recovered_at,n.summary,n.lock_version, n.created_at,n.updated_at,e.alert_cycle_ref AS cycle_ref FROM incident n JOIN alert_event e ON e.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND e.alert_event_id=n.first_event_id WHERE n.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND n.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND e.alert_cycle_ref=#{cycleRef} ORDER BY n.generation_no,n.incident_id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(generation_no),0)+1 FROM incident WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint}

SELECT n.incident_id,n.fingerprint,n.generation_no,n.status,n.event_count, n.opened_at,n.last_event_at,n.recovered_at,n.summary,n.lock_version, n.created_at,n.updated_at, (SELECT e.alert_cycle_ref FROM alert_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND e.alert_event_id=n.first_event_id) AS cycle_ref FROM incident n WHERE n.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND n.incident_id=#{incidentId} FOR UPDATE
